newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PT Selamat Sempurna up on debut.
newsitem.headline: PT Selamat Sempurna up on debut.

text.p: Indonesian spare parts producer PT Selamat Sempurna rose on its debut on the Jakarta bourse on Monday despite overall sluggish trade, brokers said.
The share rose to 1,850 rupiah in mid-morning trade on a volume of 2.6 million shares from an initial public offering price of 1,700 rupiah.
Brokers said the listing had been relatively well received, but buying had been affected by weak market sentiment following directionless regional markets.

"Selamat Samperna still has a chance to attract market attention in the next session on media reports that the government is likely to give tax incentives for automotive spare parts companies," said one local broker.
The company has floated 34.4 million of its shares on the Jakarta and Surabaya Stock Exchange to raise 58.48 billion rupiah ($24.9 million).
The company said it posted first quarter net profit of 3.03 billion rupiah. In 1995, the company posted annualised net profit of 6.97 billion rupiah.
